study_identification_part.si_4_title: Extreme deviations from the normative model reveal cortical heterogeneity and associations with negative symptom severity in first-episode psychosis from the OPTiMiSE and GAP studies

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: OPTiMiSE multi-site FEP sample; GAP and ATLAS single-site samples (GAP patients and controls, plus ATLAS controls); pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model (n=37,126).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We included data from two large samples of individuals who were recruited and assessed at the time of their first presentation to services in the Genetics and Psychosis (GAP) study, and the Optimization of Treatment and Management of Schizophrenia in Europe (OPTiMiSE) study."; "As there were fewer control participants in the older age range in the GAP sample, additional data ( n = 124) from control participants in the ATLAS study were used to supplement the sample."; "We used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model... built from healthy participant data ( n = 37,126) across 79 scanners"
